posts.raw_content:
This doesn't need to go viral or anything. I'm just grieving 14 years too late. I left USMC active duty in 2010 and found out tonight my roommate at my last unit was killed in Afghanistan in 2012. We weren't best friends or anything, but he was a good roommate. Except that he always woke up two hours earlier than me to the song "party like a rock star", and he hit snooze a lot of times. I will forever hate that song because of him. Not that I thought it was very good in the first place. He had a girlfriend, Brittney, that he married about 6 months after I left active duty. They enjoyed 1.5 years of marriage before he was killed by sniper fire in Helmand province. 
So idk, I kind of feel weird about being sad, this happened 14 years ago and I just found out tonight. I don't really know what to do with it so I'm just leaving it here.
